column12: The multiple is the most arguable figure here. For 1.0: camlipixant would enter the same position Viberzi did, a new mechanism for IBS pain, and it does not share the mu-opioid mechanism behind Viberzi's pancreatitis and severe constipation warnings, nor its contraindication in patients without a gallbladder (openFDA label, sections 4 and 5). The case for lower: the rate is applied to IBS-M, where no drug has shown what capture looks like; P2X3 antagonism showed limited efficacy in cough (6-K 0001654954-26-006705); GSK valued the IBS programme at only GBP 104mm after the cough result. The case for higher: Viberzi's revenue grew partly on price, so its patient capture is if anything understated here. On this row the US line plateaus near 92,600 patients, 2.3 times Viberzi's 2019 stock, because the pool includes IBS-M
